description: Which standard rug size fits a living room (from the room's size, leaving bare floor at the walls) or goes under a dining table (from the table's size, so chairs stay on the rug when pulled out). kind "living" takes the room in feet; kind "dining" takes the table in inches. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

kind.description: living: room size in feet. dining: table size in inches.

length.description: Room length in feet (living) or table length in inches (dining).

width.description: Room width in feet (living) or table width in inches (dining).

name: rug_size
title: Rug size calculator
